# SimpliConvert

SimpliConvert (https://simpliconvert.com/) is a free online toolkit with 529 browser-based tools. All tools run 100% client-side in the user's browser: no sign-up, no uploads, no watermarks. Categories: PDF & document tools, image & graphic tools, calculators & converters, developer & coding tools, SEO & webmaster tools, social media & creator tools, text & productivity generators.

## Tool categories
- PDF & Document Tools (15 tools): https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools
- Image & Graphic Tools (60 tools): https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools
- Calculators & Converters (228 tools): https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools
- Developer & Coding Tools (51 tools): https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools
- SEO & Webmaster Tools (36 tools): https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools
- Social Media & Creator Tools (17 tools): https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools
- Text & Productivity Generators (122 tools): https://simpliconvert.com/#all-tools
